# Hecate

> Enterprise-grade, multi-tenant, model-agnostic, MCP-first Agent platform with a self-developed Pregel execution engine. Built with Python 3.12+, FastAPI, and SQLAlchemy 2.0 async. Self-hosted; speaks MCP and A2A natively; integrates 100+ LLMs via LiteLLM; exposes an OpenAI-compatible API.

Hecate is an open-source project (MIT license) currently in **alpha (0.1.x)**. APIs may change before 1.0. Documentation follows the Diátaxis framework: **tutorials** (learn), **how-to guides** (work), **reference** (look up), and **concepts** (understand) — plus an Architecture Center with deep dives and ADRs, operations runbooks, and migration guides.

Key numbers (as of 2026-08):
- **28** Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
- **100+** features shipped in alpha
- **139** OpenSpec specs
- **11** Core + **4** SPI extension points
- **34** data models with `workspace_id` for multi-tenant isolation
- **6** multi-agent collaboration patterns (Hierarchical, Handoff, Pipeline, Broadcast, Negotiation, Debate)

## Getting started

- [Quickstart](docs/getting-started/quickstart.md): install, start infra, run migrations, send your first chat request in ~5 minutes

## Source code map

```
src/hecate/
├── engine/         # Pregel runtime, 11 core + 4 SPI extension points
├── services/       # LLM, KB, memory, tools, backup, audit, etc.
├── api/            # FastAPI routes (OpenAI-compat, management, MCP, A2A)
├── models/         # SQLAlchemy ORM + Pydantic schemas
├── cli/            # 3 entry points: hecate, hecate-migrate, hecate-flag-audit
├── auth/           # 5 providers: JWT, API key, OIDC, SAML, LDAP
├── a2a/            # A2A server + client (Linux Foundation v1.0)
├── plugin/         # Plugin system: manifest + registry + SPI
├── skill_registry/ # Unified skill abstraction (tool/skill/KB/workflow/agent)
├── budget/         # Token cost tracking + governance
├── observability/  # 4 signals: trace, metric, log, audit
├── web/            # Visual canvas (Next.js + React Flow) [separate project]
└── core/           # config, database, DI, rate limiting
```

## Key technical facts for AI assistants

When working on Hecate code, remember:

1. **Engine layer has zero external dependencies** (except `jsonschema` for DSL validation)
2. **API layer never imports engine directly** — routes through services + `EnginePort` ABC
3. **MCP and A2A are first-class protocols** — both client and server roles
4. **OpenAI-compatible API is wire-compatible** — any OpenAI client works with `base_url` change
5. **Multi-tenant by default** — 34 models with `workspace_id` for isolation
6. **OpenSpec workflow** — every feature goes through proposal → design → specs → implementation → archive
7. **Plugin manifest** — plugins declare `type`, `name`, `version`, `api_version`, `min_platform_version`, `permissions`, `entry`, `config_schema`
8. **Sessions are universal unit of work** — chat, workflows, evaluations, A2A tasks all use sessions
9. **Checkpoints are universal** — every event in execution produces a checkpoint
10. **Audit is append-only** — hash chain; SIEM forwarding; immutable
